summary: Short kerb at a junction mouth with a house 8 m away.

drivers.seclusion: House 8 m away at 11 m, more houses 17-24 m round the junction.
drivers.access_and_room: Only 19 m of kerb, ending at the give-way line of a junction.
drivers.traffic: Busy junction of two through roads.
drivers.convention: A couple of cars park on this kerb, but 2P resident-permit signs apply.

sun_shade: Open; trees shade the south end from the west.
